brief:
Luxembourg is considering independent measures against Israel after the European Union failed to agree on coordinated sanctions targeting Israeli government officials, the Palestine News Network reported. Foreign Minister Xavier Bettel indicated the country would pursue its own course following the EU's inability to reach consensus on the issue.

The breakdown in EU unity underscores persistent disagreement among member states over responses to Israeli government actions. Luxembourg's consideration of unilateral steps signals deepening frustration with the bloc's fractured approach to Israel policy and suggests some capitals are prepared to act outside the framework of collective European decision-making when consensus proves elusive.
dek: LUXEMBOURG /PNN/ Luxembourg is considering taking unilateral measures against Israel after divisions within the European Union prevented member states from agreeing on broader sanctions against members of the Israeli government, Foreign Minister Xavier Bettel…
title: Luxembourg weighs unilateral sanctions on Israel as EU fractures
